name: Nawab Abdul Ghani
contribution: As a leading Dhaka Nawab, he supported civic infrastructure and Muslim elite institutional networks in eastern Bengal.
context: His influence developed in the late-19th-century urban transformation of Dhaka under colonial governance.
impact: He remains significant in the social and civic history of Muslim leadership in Dhaka.
highlight: A major patron figure in Dhaka’s 19th-century civic history.
